caption: The drawing consists of a single outlined object on a plain, light-colored (off-white or beige) background. The object appears to be a tall, slender vessel or container composed of several distinct parts: a wide, stable base; a rounded, tapering stem; a bulbous body; a thin, curved handle on the left side attaching to the midsection; a cylindrical container at the top; and a lid with two long, straight sticks or rods protruding vertically upwards. The object is drawn with simple, fine black lines without any shading or color fill. The entire composition is centered within a rectangular border, and a small signature reading "Ruth Bialos Tosky" appears in the lower right corner.
title: Lamp
